text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since I removed
the
Kikuka Sho from Eishin Flash's
schedule, but she
still seems a bit lost.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My training schedule requires changes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This was originally designed for
long-distance
running to prepare for the
Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, except I do not know how.
Changing a single
element could cause a
total upheaval.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention, there is still a chance I
may yet
run in the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
As in continue training for long-distance
races?
choice_data_list: そのままトレーニングするのは？
choice_data_list_en: How about we just train like this?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: 目標を『有馬記念』にすればメニューに合う
choice_data_list_en: If we target the Arima Kinen, it'll fit the training plan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, but I need time to think.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For better or worse, she has a one-track
mind.
Now that her schedule's off, she
won't be able to
move forward without
some major convincing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She needs an experience that can give
her a new
perspective. I think back on
her run with Mr. C.B.
choice_data_list_en: (How can I give her a push...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. gave Eishin Flash invaluable
experience
by running with her ahead of
the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Flash might need to
experience
another setback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, a lively voice fills the air.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! This is easy peasy! ♪ Bring me
some
heavier dumbbells!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Who am I? The Invincible Teio, that's
who!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the title fits her. Tokai Teio took
on the
Classic Triple Crown with a
flawless record and
got so far as claiming
two crowns, but an injury
kept her out of
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I ask her if she could have a word
with
Eishin Flash, she agrees without
missing a beat.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So you wanna know how I felt when I
dropped out
of the Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this isn't—
choice_data_list_en: I want you to tell me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it, Flash. I agreed to this
myself, so
it's all good.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course, things were real tough when
it
happened.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There's someone who's really, really
important to
me, y'know. Can you guess
who?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
President Symboli Rudolf, I presume. I
often see
the two of you together.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Bingo! The reason why I wanted to win
the Triple
Crown was because I wanted
to be just like Prez.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And I was on a roll, too! I got to the
Derby
without a single loss, won it, and
even got praised
by Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And then, poof! I couldn't run in the last
race and
my dream went up in smoke.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yet you still race, even now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
How were you able to regain your
footing after
being thrown off the path
you were following?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I asked myself what Prez would do in my
cleats.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She'd never, ever give up. Prez would
keep
looking forward and keep
marching on.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So that's what I did.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to look bad in front of the
person I
admire!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The person you admire...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Why did you decide to share all of this
with me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's easy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Cause Prez woulda done the same!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After parting ways with Tokai Teio...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have no idea...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What those I admire—what my parents
would do
in my position. The thought
never occurred to me
at the time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to become just like them, so I
adhered
to my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yet in the end, all I was doing was
mimicking their
methods.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've strayed from their way of
doing
things, I don't know how my
parents would handle
this situation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: なら、『何ならしないか』考えるのは？
choice_data_list_en: Then, how about thinking about what not to do?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What would they absolutely not do?
That would
be...
choice_data_list: 逆なら思いつくんじゃない？
choice_data_list_en: Couldn't you think of the opposite instead?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer. In regards to my next race...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Would it be possible to run in the Japan
Cup a
year earlier than scheduled?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Runners from all over the world come to
compete
in the Japan Cup, and it goes
without saying that
only the best of the
best take part in it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I gave your suggestion some
thought—about what
the people I
admire, namely my parents, would
not
do.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They would not abandon their path.
Most likely,
they would attempt to carry
out course
corrections.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The reason I reached this conclusion is
because it
isn't right to completely scrap
a timetable once it
has been created.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, for me to correct for the
course, I must
seek a parallel route that
will lead me through the
same
difficulties as the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is the same length as the
Derby
and is held in the same venue. I've
already run
that race, so I should be
able to recover in a
month.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Since the greats of my generation are
focused on
the fall races, I would be up
against senior year
opponents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even if I do race in the Kikuka Sho, I
should take
on this challenge to
compensate for the days I've
wasted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is extremely competitive,
but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: 君ならシニア級相手でも勝負できる
貴方ならシニア級相手でも勝負できる
choice_data_list_en: You can hold your own even against Senior-class opponents.
You can hold your own even against Senior Class opponents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Now let's come up with a
strategy so I
don't have to eat my words.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It seems I am in your debt once again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I was completely lost
and had no
idea how to move forward...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But getting exposure to alternative
perspectives,
such as when I faced
against C.B., helped bring
clarity and
understanding.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I tend to get mired in my own thoughts,
so I
appreciate the outside input.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.
choice_data_list: それ以上に美点ばかりだよ
choice_data_list_en: More than that, it's full of great qualities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Eishin Flash adopts a positive
mindset
while preparing for the Japan
Cup.
